title: Queen's Gambit Declined
summary: Black holds the d5 pawn with ...e6 instead of taking on c4. Classical and solid: Black's main task is freeing the position and the c8-bishop.
plans: Hold d5 with ...e6, ...Nf6 and ...Be7, then castle.
Free your game with ...dxc4 followed by ...Nd5, or the ...c5 and ...e5 breaks.
Find a good diagonal for the light-squared bishop (...b6 and ...Bb7).
watch_for: White's minority attack (b4-b5) in the Exchange Variation, and pins with Bg5.

source.games: historical game scores (facts), replayed and checked at build time

traps.name: Elephant Trap
traps.explanation: The knight on f6 looks pinned, but 6.Nxd5? Nxd5! 7.Bxd8 Bb4+ wins back the queen and leaves Black a piece up.

traps.name: Lasker Trap (Albin Countergambit)
traps.explanation: Against the Albin, 6.Bxb4? allows ...exf2+ and the famous underpromotion ...fxg1=N+, winning material.

games.lesson: The Tartakower QGD: White fixes Black's hanging pawns, then breaks through on the f-file.
